# @swifty.js/docs — React Documentation Site Generator

`@swifty.js/docs` (`packages/swifty-docs`, published as `@swifty.js/docs`, v0.0.12, MIT) is a documentation site generator in the spirit of VitePress/Docusaurus, built on a `markdown-it` compilation pipeline and a precompiled **React 19** theme (shadcn-style primitives on Tailwind CSS v4). Markdown is compiled to static HTML at build time; a single React SPA renders it at runtime with a hand-rolled history router, built-in MiniSearch full-text search (section-level, CJK-aware; toggle with `search?: boolean`, default `true`), Shiki dual-theme code blocks, lazy Mermaid diagrams, optional AES-256-GCM password-protected pages (`docsGuardPlugin` + `DOCS_PASSWORD`), and a light/dark theme.

**Runtime & module facts (from `package.json`):** `"type": "module"`, `engines.node >= 20`, dual ESM+CJS build (`dist/index.js` / `dist/index.cjs`, `.d.ts` declarations). Runtime deps: `markdown-it` ^14, `markdown-it-container` ^4, `shiki` ^4 (lazy dynamic import), `mermaid` ^11 (lazy dynamic import), `js-yaml`, `ejs` ^3, `minisearch` ^7, `lucide-react` ^1, `zod` ^4, `clsx`, `tailwind-merge`, `class-variance-authority`, `@tailwindcss/typography`, and **`@vitejs/plugin-react`** (bundled into `swiftyDocsPlugin()`). Peer deps: `react` ^18||^19, `react-dom` ^18||^19, `tailwindcss` ^4 — none are optional (no `peerDependenciesMeta`). **Vite is the only supported bundler.** This is real React (`className`, `react-dom/client`, `react-dom/server`), NOT react-iso and NOT a Solid-style renderer.

## Three-Phase Architecture

1. **Configuration (Vite config load).** `defineConfig(config, projectRoot?)` (`src/define-config.ts`) is an identity function with a side effect: it scans the docs dir (`scanDocsDir` in `src/scanner.ts`, deterministic codepoint-sorted walk with route-collision warnings and virtual directory-index routes), auto-generates sidebars (`generateSidebar` in `src/sidebar-generator.ts`), prefixes internal links with `baseUrl` (`joinBase`, idempotent), and renders `file-content.ejs` into `.swifty-docs/generated/index.js` (byte-stable — no timestamp). That module exports `loadContent`, `docsConfig`, `getSearchIndex`, and `onContentUpdate`, imported through the `@swifty-docs/generated` Vite alias.
2. **Compilation (Vite plugin).** `swiftyDocsPlugin({ config, debug? })` (`src/vite.ts`) returns `[swifty-docs, swifty-docs:base-sync, swifty-docs:spa-fallback, ...react()]`. Its `resolveId` (enforce `pre`) tags `.md` imports with a `?swifty-docs` suffix; its `load` hook runs `compileMarkdown()` (`src/compile-markdown.ts`): extract YAML frontmatter → create markdown-it parser + 4 custom plugins → lazy-init Shiki singleton → parse + render HTML → build `PageData` via the shared `buildPageData()` (`src/utils/page-data.ts`) → emit a JS module exporting `{ pageData, contentHtml }`. `docsGuardPlugin()` (enforce `post`) AES-256-GCM-encrypts `contentHtml` of pages with `protected: true` frontmatter when `DOCS_PASSWORD` is set, and scrubs excerpt/description/headings from `pageData` so protected content never leaks into search.
3. **Runtime (browser).** `<DocsProvider>` (Zod-validates config/loaders/`onContentUpdate` at the boundary, exposes `searchEnabled`, holds search-dialog state) wraps `<LocationProvider>` (the package's own history router in `theme/lib/router.tsx`) and `<DocsLayout>`. `DocsLayout` reads the path from `useLocation()`, loads content in a `useEffect`, and renders Navbar / Sidebar / prose column (`ContentRenderer` + `PrevNext`) / Toc / mobile drawer, and mounts `SearchDialog` only when `searchEnabled`. `ContentRenderer` injects `contentHtml`, then mounts React roots into `[swifty-docs-toc]`, `.mermaid-block`, and code-block copy-button holders.

## Consumer Setup (canonical example)

The package's own docs site is the working example: `swifty-docs.config.ts`, `app/main.tsx`, `app/index.html`, `app/main.css`, `vite.config.ts` at the package root. Mirror it when scaffolding.

```bash
pnpm add @swifty.js/docs react react-dom tailwindcss @tailwindcss/vite @tailwindcss/typography
```

1. **`swifty-docs.config.ts`** — `import { defineConfig } from "@swifty.js/docs/vite"` and export a `DocsConfig`.
2. **`vite.config.ts`** — spread `swiftyDocsPlugin({ config })` (returns a plugin **array** incl. `@vitejs/plugin-react`), add `docsGuardPlugin()` if using protected pages, add `tailwindcss()`, and alias `"@swifty-docs/generated"` → `resolve(root, ".swifty-docs/generated")`. Gitignore `.swifty-docs/`.
3. **CSS entry** — `@import "tailwindcss"; @import "@swifty.js/docs/client.css";`. The published `client.css` already contains `@source "./theme-chunk.js"`, so Tailwind picks up the precompiled theme's utility classes automatically (no manual `@source` needed).
4. **JS entry** (`app/main.tsx`) — render `<DocsProvider config={docsConfig} loadContent={loadContent} getSearchIndex={getSearchIndex} onContentUpdate={onContentUpdate}>` around `<LocationProvider><DocsLayout /></LocationProvider>` with `createRoot(...).render(...)`. Wrap `loadContent` with `createContentGuard()` for protected pages. Add a no-FOUC inline script in `index.html` that toggles `.dark` from the `swifty-docs-theme` localStorage key before first paint (the script must hardcode the key; `THEME_STORAGE_KEY` is for bundled code).
5. **TypeScript** — `/// <reference types="@swifty.js/docs/client" />` in a shims file supplies the ambient `@swifty-docs/generated` module declaration; add a `paths` mapping for IDE resolution.

## Working Rules

- **Ground answers in the source.** Key files: `src/types.ts` (shared types), `src/vite.ts` (plugins incl. docs-guard), `src/define-config.ts` (generation), `src/compile-markdown.ts` (pipeline), `src/utils/page-data.ts` (shared PageData builder), `src/file-content.ejs` (generated module), `src/client.css` (all styling), `src/theme/**` (components), `src/markdown/plugins/*`. Read the file rather than guessing.
- **It is real React 19.** Components use `react` hooks, `className`, `react-dom/client` `createRoot`, and `react-dom/server` `renderToString` (build-time icons + denied-page HTML). Routing is the package's own `LocationProvider`/`useLocation` (`theme/lib/router.tsx`), not react-iso. The Dialog primitive is a hand-rolled `createPortal` (from `react-dom`) with an Escape handler, focus trap, and focus restore.
- **markdown-it plugins return HTML strings, not JSX.** Render functions in `src/markdown/plugins/` emit strings (some split open/close tags); escape interpolated values with the shared `escapeHtml` from `src/utils/escape-html.ts` (single source). Emit `<pre>` content on one line — `<pre>` preserves whitespace.
- **Slugs are deduplicated per document.** Both the anchor plugin and `extractPageMeta` use `createSlugger()` (`src/utils/slugify.ts`) so duplicate headings get `-1`/`-2` suffixes and TOC slugs always match rendered `id`s. Never slugify per-document headings with bare `slugify()`. Slugs preserve CJK (`\p{L}\p{N}`) and prefix a leading digit with `_`.
- **Style customization = override CSS custom properties.** Consumers redefine `--primary`, `--background`, etc. after importing `client.css` (see `references/theming.md`). There is no `--border`/`--ring`/`--card` token — borders reuse `--muted`, focus rings reuse `--primary`.
- **Regenerating routes requires re-running `defineConfig`.** It runs at Vite config load, so adding/removing `.md` files needs a dev-server restart (the watcher logs and full-reloads on add/unlink). Editing an existing page hot-reloads via `onContentUpdate`.
- **Runtime `@/` imports must be `import type` only in `src/`.** The config-load chain runs under Node without the alias; use relative imports for values.
- Dev commands (run in `packages/swifty-docs`): `pnpm dev` (docs site, `--mode docs`), `pnpm build` (lib, `--mode lib`), `pnpm build:docs`, `pnpm test` (vitest), `pnpm typecheck`.
